slides: The zero-willpower tracking cheat sheet. Save this one.
1. Photograph the plate before you eat, not after. Memory edits itself.

3. Edit the estimate instead of deleting the entry.
4. A broken streak gets repaired, not restarted from zero.
5. Track what you actually ordered, not what you meant to order.
None of these require willpower. They just remove the moments where people quit.
Save this BiteBuddy guide for your next attempt.

slides: Stop starting over every Monday. That is the actual habit to break.
Monday feels like a clean slate, so the whole week before it gets erased.
Erasing a decent Tuesday through Friday because Saturday went sideways is the real problem.
A week is not one score. It is seven separate days.
The days you tracked still count, even next to the days you did not.
The app should treat a gap as a gap, not a failed week.
The goal is not a perfect week. It is more tracked days than untracked ones.
